title: Oppenheimer's late speech on abolishing nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: As Openheimer said in his one of his last speeches that he gave u to his scientists, uh, we can't afford to think that we can't abolish all nuclear weapons.

plain: In one of his last speeches to his scientists, J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the building of the first atomic bomb, is said to have told them that they could not afford to believe nuclear weapons can't be abolished. A former Air Force missile officer named Robert Salas, who says a UFO once shut down ten of the nuclear missiles in his care, quotes the line to Michels. He uses it to back his case that the world must get rid of nuclear weapons.
